scope: Previously used comparison cohorts, not new independent validation. Community labels do not validate visible sex/stage evidence. Thresholds selected only on original validation partition.

quantization.method: Fold fp16 constant casts, ORT basic preprocessing, dynamic per-channel uint8 MatMul/Gemm

adultOnlyTrial.selection: Selected from original validation results before evaluating that threshold on test and before collecting fresh-stage photos; both-label stage trial failed.
adultOnlyTrial.limitations: Community labels; four juveniles in fresh cohort is limited negative coverage. Attribution-string exclusion cannot certify observer independence. No exact-age inference.
